I love to bring stories to life real stories of the guests I interview on my podcast, the life experiences I write about, and the characters I create in my fictional worlds.

feeds.description: A space dedicated to Black women entrepreneurs — Cassandra Hill's blog offers resources on holistic wellness, faith, business mindset, and self-love to help Black women thrive personally and professionally.

Ronke Lawal, an award-winning PR strategist and personal branding coach, explores topics like visibility, cultural capital, and entrepreneurship — all through the lens of her lived experience as a Black British businesswoman.

Through her posts, she shares her journey in fashion PR, styling, creative direction, and the real realities of hustle culture—all with the goal of empowering other Black creatives and entrepreneurs.
